newsitem.title: USA: Dyneco, Coltec in licensing deal.
newsitem.headline: Dyneco, Coltec in licensing deal.

text.p: Dyneco Corp said Monday it entered into a technology and patent licensing agreement with Coltec Industries Inc.

The agreement gives Coltec exclusive rights to manufacture and sell vacuum pumps based on patents and technology related to DynEco's Orbital Vane mechanisms. The pumps are in the range of 1/2 to 10 horsepower.
The license covers North and South America, Southeast Asia and the Pacific Rim, including Japan, China, South Korea and Australia.
The annual market for vacuum pumps is estimated at more than $50 million in the United States alone, Dyneco said.
